text:
elaine: Heads-up — PR #612 adds a compact 'Optimize migration' subsection focused on batching, kv prefetch, and a quant profile example. Need docs sanity review and a 3-bullet migration checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood/optimize/pull/612 :link:
mike: Thanks. Can we include a tiny micro-benchmark (10 prompts) with token/cost delta so reviewers can eyeball impact? Keep examples runnable and language-diverse (add Ruby snippet).
anya: Minimal Python snippet (v2 SDK) showing batch + kv prefetch:```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key='${REDWOOD}')
outs = client.batch.text.generate([
  { 'model': 'redwood/opt-lite', 'prompt': 'Summarize logs' },
  { 'model': 'redwood/opt-lite', 'prompt': 'List errors' }
], options={ 'kv_prefetch': True })
for o in outs:
  print(o.text)
```
kevin: Compact quant YAML suggestion to include in docs:```yaml
precision: q8_0
kv_prefetch: true
short_input:
  max_tokens: 10
  fallback_precision: float32
```
kevin: Note: recommend starting with q8_0 for throughput/ram wins; only try q4_0 if you need extra memory savings and have a robust eval set.
anya: Ruby snippet (tiny) to show diversity:```rb
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD'])
res = client.batch.text.generate([
  { model: 'redwood/opt-lite', prompt: 'Summarize logs' },
  { model: 'redwood/opt-lite', prompt: 'List errors' }
], options: { kv_prefetch: true })
res.each { |r| puts r.text }
```
elaine: For the PR description, I've drafted a short migration checklist (3 bullets): 1) update examples to v2 batch/text APIs, 2) add compact quant YAML with short-input fallback, 3) run a 10-prompt smoke eval and paste tokens/cost/latency delta. Please validate and attach numbers.
mike: I'll run the smoke eval (float32 vs q8_0) and post a tiny table in PR comments by EOD. Proposed table format: columns: mode | total tokens | avg latency (ms) | approx cost.
docs-bot: label applied: docs/needs-review
elaine: Also: add a one-line cost heuristic to the docs: "Expect ~2–3.5x memory reduction with q8_0; validate on a representative prompt set." Add a Console link anchor to the quant profiles page.
kevin: Small troubleshooting note to include: if short prompts show odd probability shifts, increase short_input.max_tokens or use float32 for that endpoint. Link to Eval playbook in a parenthetical.
anya: LGTM on examples. I'll tidy wording and push a small wording patch to the PR.
elaine: Thanks — on merge can docs-bot post a changelog blurb and ping #release-war-room with the checklist attached?
docs-bot: will post changelog and notify #release-war-room on merge.
